title: New Nautics and University of Florida project to hack the brain's endogenous DMT system (EDMTX)

tellings.quote: with with New Nordics. We've we've hired the University of uh or contracted with a team at the University of Florida um to actually develop techniques to hack the brain's endogenous DMT system.

plain: A company called New Nautics has hired a team at the University of Florida to find ways to "hack" the brain's own DMT system. DMT is a powerful psychedelic that the body also makes on its own in small amounts, and the project is called EDMTX. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who says he is part of the effort, tells Michels the aim is "to actually develop techniques to hack the brain's endogenous DMT system," meaning the DMT the brain makes for itself.
